args.query: SELECT brand, sector, count(*) as cnt FROM facts WHERE brand='E.Leclerc' GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT review_id, at, rating, title, text, sentiment, aspects FROM facts WHERE brand='E.Leclerc' AND at >= '2026-11-08' AND at <= '2026-11-12' AND sentiment='negative' LIMIT 10
SELECT aspect, count(*) as cnt FROM mentions m JOIN facts f ON m.review_id = f.review_id WHERE f.brand='E.Leclerc' AND f.at >= '2026-11-08' AND f.at <= '2026-11-12' GROUP BY aspect ORDER BY cnt DESC

args.what_happened: On November 10, 2026, E.Leclerc faced 48 negative reviews (a z-score spike of 10.61 compared to the usual 6.6 per day). Users overwhelmingly reported that version 11.0.1 crashes on startup ("Impossible à ouvrir", "ne fonctionne plus") and prevents users from logging into their accounts ("Impossible de me connecter à mon compte depuis la MAJ").
args.headline: E.Leclerc experienced a 10.61 z-score complaint spike on Nov 10, 2026, driven by app version 11.0.1 startup crashes and login failures.
args.impact: 48 negative reviews on Nov 10 (vs 6.6 usual per day); app_reliability and login_access are top key drivers of rating loss (0.287 and 0.103 stars lost respectively).

actions.expected_effect: Restore app reliability and stop the influx of negative reviews regarding app crashes and login failures
actions.action: Roll back v11.0.1 or immediately issue hotfix v11.0.2 resolving startup crashes and login loop failures
Establish pre-release regression testing for authentication and cold-start flows on iOS and Android
actions.expected_effect: Prevent faulty version updates from reaching production and causing severe z-score spikes

actions.action: Publish an in-app notice and social/store response acknowledging the version 11 login/crash bug with an ETA for the patch
actions.expected_effect: Mitigate customer frustration and reduce churn among loyal card-holders and regular shoppers

args.root_cause: Release of app version 11.0.1 introduced critical bugs causing app startup crashes and authentication/login failures.
